Explicitly seeded samplers. Every call starts its own stream from the seed. See [Seeded sampling](../rng.qmd).

## Uniform, categorical, and permutations

### `dist_uniform_rng()` {#dist_uniform_rng}

Uniform(min, max) samples as R's runif(): min + (max - min) * u; min == max gives min. Local ChaCha20 stream restarted at the seed, one uniform per draw; same seed/arguments reproduce prefixes within the pinned version.

```php
Phit\dist_uniform_rng(
    int $n,
    int $seed,
    float $min = 0.0,
    float $max = 1.0,
): array
```

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `$n` | `int` | required | Sample count in [0, 1000000] |
| `$seed` | `int` | required | Nonnegative PHP integer; every call restarts its own stream |
| `$min` | `float` | `0.0` | Lower bound |
| `$max` | `float` | `1.0` | Upper bound, ≥ min |

**Returns** `list<float>`

**Errors** Invalid input (1001), nonfinite input (1003) or more than 1000000 draws (1007).

**See also** [Details](../rng.qmd#uniform-categorical-and-permutation-sampling) · [Example](../examples/distributions.qmd)

### `dist_categorical_rng()` {#dist_categorical_rng}

0-based indices into prob drawn with those probabilities, as R's sample(x, n, replace = TRUE, prob = prob): the first k with u * sum(prob) < prob[0] + ... + prob[k]. Weights are divided by their sum. Local ChaCha20 stream restarted at the seed, one uniform per draw; same seed/arguments reproduce prefixes within the pinned version.

```php
Phit\dist_categorical_rng(
    int $n,
    int $seed,
    array $prob,
): array
```

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `$n` | `int` | required | Sample count in [0, 1000000] |
| `$seed` | `int` | required | Nonnegative PHP integer; every call restarts its own stream |
| `$prob` | `array` | required | Finite, nonnegative weights with a positive sum |

**Returns** `list<int>`

**Errors** Invalid input (1001), nonfinite input (1003) or more than 1000000 draws (1007).

**See also** [Details](../rng.qmd#uniform-categorical-and-permutation-sampling)

### `dist_categorical_rows_rng()` {#dist_categorical_rows_rng}

One 0-based index per row of prob, drawn with that row's probabilities (e.g. ordered-logit outcomes). Draw i uses the i-th uniform, so equal rows give dist_categorical_rng()'s result. Local ChaCha20 stream restarted at the seed, one uniform per draw; same seed/arguments reproduce prefixes within the pinned version.

```php
Phit\dist_categorical_rows_rng(
    int $seed,
    array $prob,
): array
```

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `$seed` | `int` | required | Nonnegative PHP integer; every call restarts its own stream |
| `$prob` | `array` | required | At most 1000000 rows of finite, nonnegative weights with a positive sum |

**Returns** `list<int>`

**Errors** Invalid input (1001), nonfinite input (1003) or more than 1000000 draws (1007).

**See also** [Details](../rng.qmd#uniform-categorical-and-permutation-sampling)

### `permutation_rng()` {#permutation_rng}

size distinct 0-based indices from 0..n-1 in random order, as R's sample(n, size) less one; size null gives all n. Partial Fisher-Yates: step i swaps position i with i + floor(u * (n - i)). Local ChaCha20 stream restarted at the seed, one uniform per draw; same seed/arguments reproduce prefixes within the pinned version.

```php
Phit\permutation_rng(
    int $n,
    int $seed,
    ?int $size = NULL,
): array
```

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `$n` | `int` | required | Population size in [0, 1000000] |
| `$seed` | `int` | required | Nonnegative PHP integer; every call restarts its own stream |
| `$size` | `?int` | `NULL` | Draws in [0, n]; null gives a permutation |

**Returns** `list<int>`

**Errors** Invalid input (1001), nonfinite input (1003) or more than 1000000 draws (1007).

**See also** [Details](../rng.qmd#uniform-categorical-and-permutation-sampling)
